premise: Little Fish counts his friends in the rock pool and only gets to three, worried someone is missing, until Clam asks who is doing the counting.
inspiration: The folk tale of the counters who forget themselves (the six travellers who count only five), told as a giggle: the missing one is the counter.

en-US.title: Counting in the Pool
en-US.text: {clam:enter} [playfully] {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Little Fish was counting his friends. {fish:face happy} One… {clam:pulse} Clam, at the bottom, quiet as a pebble. Two… {urchin:enter} {urchin:pulse} Urchin, round and purple and wiggly. Three… {shrimp:enter} {shrimp:pulse} Shrimp, pink and quick, zipping about. {fish:face sad} [nervously] Three? But there were four of us this morning! {fish:live look-around} He counted again. One, two, three. [sad] Oh no. One of us is missing! {urchin:live wiggle} Urchin wiggled his spines. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:live laugh} Shrimp giggled. {clam:live peek} Clam opened up, and closed again. [playfully] Little Fish, she said, who's doing the counting? {fish:face surprised} Me! said Little Fish… and then he understood. [laughs] FOUR! I forgot to count ME! {fish:live wiggle} He wiggled his tail and fluttered his fins. {urchin:face happy} {clam:face happy} {shrimp:hearts} One, two, three… and four. Everyone was right where they should be.

es-ES.title: Contando en la charca
es-ES.text: {clam:enter} [playfully] {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pececito estaba contando a sus amigos. {fish:face happy} Uno… {clam:pulse} Almeja, en el fondo, callada como una piedra. Dos… {urchin:enter} {urchin:pulse} Erizo, redondo, morado y meneón. Tres… {shrimp:enter} {shrimp:pulse} Gamba, rosa y rapidísima, de aquí para allá. {fish:face sad} [nervously] ¿Tres? ¡Pero esta mañana éramos cuatro! {fish:live look-around} Volvió a contar. Uno, dos, tres. [sad] ¡Ay, no! ¡Falta uno! {urchin:live wiggle} Erizo meneó sus pinchos. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:live laugh} Gamba se rió. {clam:live peek} Almeja se abrió, y se volvió a cerrar. [playfully] Pececito, dijo, ¿quién está contando? {fish:face surprised} ¡Yo!, dijo Pececito… y entonces lo entendió. [laughs] ¡CUATRO! ¡Se me olvidó contarME! {fish:live wiggle} Meneó la cola y agitó las aletas. {urchin:face happy} {clam:face happy} {shrimp:hearts} Uno, dos, tres… y cuatro. Todos estaban justo donde tenían que estar.

ja-JP.title: ひとり たりない？
ja-JP.text: {clam:enter}[playfully]{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}おさかなくんが、潮だまりのおともだちを、かぞえています。{fish:face happy}いーち…{clam:pulse}水のそこで、小石みたいにしずかな、貝さん。にーい…{urchin:enter}{urchin:pulse}まんまるで、むらさきで、もぞもぞの、ウニくん。さーん…{shrimp:enter}{shrimp:pulse}ピンクで、すばしっこい、エビさん。{fish:face sad}[nervously]三人？けさは、四人だったのに！{fish:live look-around}もういちど、かぞえます。いち、に、さん。[sad]たいへん、ひとりたりない！{urchin:live wiggle}ウニくんは、とげをもぞもぞ。{shrimp:face happy}{shrimp:live laugh}エビさんは、くすくす。{clam:live peek}貝さんが、ぱかっとひらいて、またとじました。[playfully]「おさかなくん、かぞえているのは、だあれ？」 {fish:face surprised}「ぼく！」 とこたえて…おさかなくんは、はっとしました。[laughs]「四人だ！ぼく、じぶんをかぞえるの、わすれてた！」 {fish:live wiggle}しっぽをぴちぴち、ひれをひらひら。{urchin:face happy}{clam:face happy}{shrimp:hearts}いち、に、さん…そして、よん。みんな、ちゃーんといました。

de-DE.title: Wer fehlt denn da?
de-DE.text: {clam:enter} [playfully] {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Das Fischchen zählte seine Freunde. {fish:face happy} Eins… {clam:pulse} die Muschel, ganz unten am Grund, still wie ein Kieselstein. Zwei… {urchin:enter} {urchin:pulse} der Seeigel, rund und lila und zappelig. Drei… {shrimp:enter} {shrimp:pulse} die Garnele, rosa und flink, die hin und her flitzte. {fish:face sad} [nervously] Drei? Aber heute Morgen waren wir doch vier! {fish:live look-around} Das Fischchen zählte noch mal nach. Eins, zwei, drei. [sad] Oje. Einer von uns fehlt! {urchin:live wiggle} Der Seeigel wackelte mit den Stacheln. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:live laugh} Die Garnele kicherte. {clam:live peek} Die Muschel ging auf und klappte wieder zu. [playfully] „Fischchen“, sagte sie, „wer zählt denn hier?“ {fish:face surprised} „Ich!“, sagte das Fischchen… und da ging ihm ein Licht auf. [laughs] „VIER! Ich hab MICH vergessen!“ {fish:live wiggle} Es wedelte mit dem Schwanz und flatterte mit den Flossen. {urchin:face happy} {clam:face happy} {shrimp:hearts} Eins, zwei, drei… und vier. Alle waren genau da, wo sie hingehörten.

fr-FR.title: On compte dans la mare
fr-FR.text: {clam:enter} [playfully] {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Petit Poisson comptait ses amis. {fish:face happy} Un… {clam:pulse} Palourde, tout au fond, muette comme une carpe. Deux… {urchin:enter} {urchin:pulse} Oursin, tout rond, tout violet, tout gigotant. Trois… {shrimp:enter} {shrimp:pulse} Crevette, toute rose et toute rapide, qui filait de-ci, de-là. {fish:face sad} [nervously] Trois ? Mais ce matin, on était quatre ! {fish:live look-around} Il a recompté. Un, deux, trois. [sad] Oh non. Il en manque un ! {urchin:live wiggle} Oursin a remué ses piquants. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:live laugh} Crevette a pouffé de rire. {clam:live peek} Palourde s’est ouverte, puis refermée. [playfully] « Petit Poisson, a-t-elle dit, qui est-ce qui compte ? » {fish:face surprised} « Moi ! » a dit Petit Poisson… et là, il a compris. [laughs] « QUATRE ! J’ai oublié de me compter, MOI ! » {fish:live wiggle} Il a remué la queue et agité ses nageoires. {urchin:face happy} {clam:face happy} {shrimp:hearts} Un, deux, trois… et quatre. Chacun était bien à sa place.

it-IT.title: Chi manca nella pozza?
it-IT.text: {clam:enter} [playfully] {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pesciolino contava i suoi amici. {fish:face happy} Uno… {clam:pulse} Vongola, sul fondo, zitta zitta come un sassolino. Due… {urchin:enter} {urchin:pulse} Riccio, tondo tondo e viola, che si dimenava. Tre… {shrimp:enter} {shrimp:pulse} Gamberetto, rosa e velocissimo, che sfrecciava qua e là. {fish:face sad} [nervously] Tre? Ma stamattina eravamo in quattro! {fish:live look-around} Ha contato di nuovo. Uno, due, tre. [sad] Oh no. Manca qualcuno! {urchin:live wiggle} Riccio ha agitato gli aculei. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:live laugh} Gamberetto ha ridacchiato. {clam:live peek} Vongola si è aperta, e si è richiusa. [playfully] «Pesciolino», ha detto, «ma chi è che sta contando?» {fish:face surprised} «Io!», ha detto Pesciolino… e allora ha capito. [laughs] «QUATTRO! Mi sono dimenticato di contare ME!» {fish:live wiggle} Ha agitato la coda e ha sventolato le pinne. {urchin:face happy} {clam:face happy} {shrimp:hearts} Uno, due, tre… e quattro. Erano tutti proprio al loro posto.

zh-TW.title: 少了誰呢？
zh-TW.text: {clam:enter}[playfully]{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}小魚在數牠的好朋友。{fish:face happy}一……{clam:pulse}蛤蜊，躲在池底，安安靜靜，像一顆小石頭。二……{urchin:enter}{urchin:pulse}海膽，圓滾滾、紫紫的，還會扭來扭去。三……{shrimp:enter}{shrimp:pulse}小蝦，粉紅色的，好快好快，咻來咻去。{fish:face sad}[nervously]「三個？可是今天早上，我們明明有四個呀！」 {fish:live look-around}牠又數了一次。一、二、三。[sad]「糟糕，少了一個！」 {urchin:live wiggle}海膽搖搖牠的刺。{shrimp:face happy}{shrimp:live laugh}小蝦咯咯笑。{clam:live peek}蛤蜊打開殼，又關起來。[playfully]「小魚呀，」 蛤蜊說，「是誰在數數呢？」 {fish:face surprised}「我呀！」 小魚說……說完，牠就懂了。[laughs]「四個！我忘了數我自己！」 {fish:live wiggle}牠搖搖尾巴，拍拍小鰭。{urchin:face happy}{clam:face happy}{shrimp:hearts}一、二、三……還有四。大家都在，一個也沒少。

zh-HK.title: 石池點人數
zh-HK.text: {clam:enter}[playfully]{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}小魚在石池裏數朋友。{fish:face happy}一……{clam:pulse}蜆，躺在池底，靜得像一顆小石子。二……{urchin:enter}{urchin:pulse}海膽，圓圓的，紫紫的，扭來扭去。三……{shrimp:enter}{shrimp:pulse}小蝦，粉紅色，快得很，咻咻咻游來游去。{fish:face sad}[nervously]「三個？今朝明明有四個㗎！」 {fish:live look-around}牠再數一次：一、二、三。[sad]「弊喇！唔見咗一個！」 {urchin:live wiggle}海膽搖搖身上的刺。{shrimp:face happy}{shrimp:live laugh}小蝦嘻嘻地笑。{clam:live peek}蜆張開殼，又合上了。[playfully]蜆問：「小魚，邊個喺度數緊呀？」 {fish:face surprised}「我呀！」 小魚說……然後，牠明白了。[laughs]「四個！我漏咗數自己呀！」 {fish:live wiggle}牠擺擺尾巴，拍拍魚鰭。{urchin:face happy}{clam:face happy}{shrimp:hearts}一、二、三……還有四。大家都在，一個也沒少。

blub.prompt: a single playful bubble rising and popping in a rock pool
